=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_detect_merge_conflicts.sh | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `auto/update-workflows-*` guard clears `MERGE_CONFLICT` and `CONFLICT_RESOLVED` and returns, so an updater PR already conflicted before review can skip both review and resolver steps without recording that it was unresolved.
  WHY: The run may finish green without reviewer output or a log line explaining the skip; later steps gated on `MERGE_CONFLICT != 'true'` run as if clean. The review reports this as an observability and wasted-run issue, not a merge-safety issue.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The plan says: "The updater stages only consumer paths on the signed `allowed_consumer_paths` list. Any other staged path fails the run before commit (Q51)." In "Commit and push updates", before `git commit`, it asks for a path policy check that fails with `ERR_SYNC_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED`. Source: docs/plans/safeguarded-consumer-workflow-updater-plan.md, lines 42, 104-138 and 200. That plan file is in this repository.
  Expected change site: scripts/release_manifest.py and ai-memory/schemas/release_manifest.v1.json need an `allowed_consumer_paths` field. The "Commit and push updates" step (`id: commit_push`) in .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml needs the check before `git commit`.
  Evidence of absence: The manifest schema allows only `schema_version`, `repository`, `release_sha`, `tag` and `files`, with `additionalProperties: false`. There is no `allowed_consumer_paths`. No hunk in update_workflows.yml compares staged paths against a list or emits `ERR_SYNC_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED`. So the direct-push path, which is still the default, has no path policy. `verify-pr-tree` covers only the opt-in PR path, and only after the push. The code comments say the plan "could not be read" and cite `safeguarded-consumer-updater-plan.md`. That name differs from the committed `safeguarded-consumer-workflow-updater-plan.md`. Earlier editors marked this item `TASK_GAP_DEFERRED`. The plan does not mark it as a follow-up. Unless project #6902 follows a different plan, this is still a gap.
  Severity: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
